text:
Priya: Quick sync — how should we sequence Dedicated vs Private investments for H2? Customers asking for both; limited eng cycles. Thinking RICE + customer cohort prioritization. Any strong opinions?
Jordan: +1 to formalizing RICE here. Also: Dedicated = faster path to revenue. Private = high-touch, longer sales cycles.
Alex: I'd push for shared infra work first. If we build the runtime and deployment abstractions to support both, marginal cost of shipping Private drops. So parallel tracks but staggered milestones.
Sarah: From PM interviews: 3 enterprise prospects need VPC/KMS now (privacy regs). That’s higher impact per customer but low reach. RICE might deprioritize it unless we segment by ARR potential.
Matt: Important launch criteria for Private (MVP): 1) private control plane + customer-managed data plane option, 2) KMS integration, 3) install/upgrade doc + automated smoke tests, 4) support playbook. Without those, can't sell SLAs.
Priya: Can someone throw quick RICE sketches for both? Even rough numbers so we can compare.
Alex: Rough: Dedicated -> Reach 8, Impact 5, Confidence 70, Effort 5. Private -> Reach 3, Impact 8, Confidence 50, Effort 13.
Jordan: quick calc (very rough):
```
Dedicated: (8*5*0.7)/5 = 5.6
Private: (3*8*0.5)/13 = 0.92
```
So Dedicated scores much higher unless we change effort or confidence assumptions.
Sarah: That matches qualitative feedback. But note private deals have >3x ACV when they land. RICE underweights high-ACV low-reach work.
Matt: We should add a revenue-weighted factor or segment RICE by customer cohort. For enterprise pipeline, treat private as high-impact strategic bet.
Priya: Good point. Proposal: short-term (Q3) focus on Dedicated enhancements that unlock predictable capacity and self-serve reserved pools. Parallel: start Private MVP for top 2 pipeline customers on a funded pilot (eng time paid by customer). That reduces our effort cost. Thoughts?
Jordan: Funded pilots are great — reduces engineering risk and cost. For Dedicated, prioritize: autoscaling polish, SLA pages, and simpler tenant isolation (enough for many customers).
Alex: Technical note: if we implement a pluggable deployment adapter (k8s-hosted vs airgap), Private engineering is mostly adapters + onboarding docs. That should cut effort by ~40%.
Matt: Add launch criteria checklist for both in the roadmap ticket: security review, KMS tested, rollback plan, canary, monitoring dashboards, runbook.
deploy-bot: Created ticket PROD-789: "Dedicated capacity + Private MVP sequencing" and assigned to @Alex @Sarah.
Priya: Excellent. Next steps: Alex to estimate adapter work + blocker list; Sarah to qualify top 2 pilots and commercial terms; Jordan to draft revenue-segmentation tweaks to prioritization framework. We'll reconvene in 1 week. :thumbsup:
